title: Provision PostgreSQL 14 on RDS
description: Provision the primary PostgreSQL database for Atlas on Amazon RDS using PostgreSQL 14 with one read replica (db.r6g.large).
resolution_notes: Provisioned PostgreSQL 14 primary and replica in the production VPC. Backups enabled.

title: Introduce Redis cache-aside for product catalog
description: Catalog reads have p95 of 850ms and Postgres CPU at 85% under load. Introduce a Redis (ElastiCache 7.0) cache-aside layer for catalog product reads. Initial TTL 300 seconds. Target hit ratio 80%.
resolution_notes: Implemented and deployed on 2024-03-18. p95 for GET /v2/products dropped from 850ms to about 210ms. Initial hit ratio 62%.

title: Migrate JWT signing from HS256 to RS256
description: Replace HS256 shared-secret signing with RS256 asymmetric signing. Reduce access token lifetime from 60 minutes to 15 minutes. Refresh tokens stay at 7 days.
resolution_notes: Completed. Private key lives only in auth-service. Gateway verifies with public key. Keys stored in AWS Secrets Manager with 90 day rotation.

title: Upgrade PostgreSQL from 14 to 16
description: Upgrade the Atlas RDS instance from PostgreSQL 14 to PostgreSQL 16 during a Saturday maintenance window.
resolution_notes: Upgrade performed on 2024-10-19 with 18 minutes of planned downtime. All services validated against 16. Reporting queries about 12% faster.

title: Evaluate adding a GraphQL API
description: Frontend team asks whether Atlas should expose a GraphQL endpoint in addition to REST.
resolution_notes: Closed as won't do. Atlas v2 stays REST only. Revisit after general availability if partners request it.

title: Connection pool exhaustion at peak load
description: During load tests, services fail with pool timeout errors. DB_POOL_MAX is set to 20 per service instance.
resolution_notes: Raised DB_POOL_MAX from 20 to 40 per instance and set DB_POOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS to 30. Load test passes.

title: Refresh token replay possible after rotation
description: A previously used refresh token could be replayed and still produced a valid access token.
resolution_notes: Added refresh token rotation with reuse detection. Presenting a used token now revokes the whole token family.

title: Order service 5xx during rolling deploy on 2024-08-22
description: order-service returned 5xx errors from 14:07 to 14:19 UTC while a rolling update was in progress.
resolution_notes: Root cause: a migration renamed a column still read by old pods running during the rolling update. Fix: rollback of the migration. Follow-ups: blue-green deployments (ATL-129), expand/contract migration rule, 2 PR approvals.

title: Implement blue-green deployments
description: Implement blue-green deployments for api-gateway and order-service, then extend to the remaining services, to avoid mixed-version rollouts.
resolution_notes: Blue-green is live for all services. Traffic switching is done at the load balancer and rollback is a traffic switch back.

title: Search index lag after bulk catalog sync
description: After the nightly bulk sync, OpenSearch results lag by up to 10 minutes.
resolution_notes: Switched to incremental indexing from catalog.updated events and reduced SEARCH_BULK_BATCH from 500 to 200. Lag is now under 30 seconds.

title: Increase catalog cache TTL from 300s to 600s
description: Cache hit ratio is 62% against a target of 85%. Raise CATALOG_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS from 300 to 600 as agreed in the team discussion.
resolution_notes: Deployed on 2024-06-20. Hit ratio rose from 62% to 88%. Note: DOC-003 was not updated and still lists 300s.

title: Lower p95 latency alert threshold from 500ms to 400ms
description: Update the Prometheus alert rule for API p95 latency so it fires above 400ms for 5 minutes instead of 500ms.
resolution_notes: Alert rule updated in production on 2024-12-18. DOC-009 draft not yet revised.

title: Stale prices after catalog update
description: Retailers see old prices for several minutes after updating a product because cache entries only expire by TTL.
resolution_notes: Implemented event-based invalidation: catalog-service consumes catalog.updated and deletes affected Redis keys. TTL (600s) remains as a fallback.

title: Add per-endpoint rate limits
description: Proposal to add separate rate limits per endpoint, for example a lower limit for the bulk import endpoint. Design under review and not yet in production.

title: Reconcile rate limit mismatch between API spec and gateway
description: API spec (v2.3) states 100 requests per minute per key while gateway configuration states 120. Determine the intended limit and align the spec, the config reference and the gateway.
